xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #3167 — pr:watch CI weather reason codes + review-cycle thrash caps

plan.title: feat(pr-watch,review-cycle): ci_never_scheduled + capacity-stall reason codes and babysit thrash caps

narratives.Description: Under Blacksmith capacity thrash or Actions outages, babysit and drive-to:merge-ready workers thrash on re-push and long watches even when Greptile is CLEAN. This story adds machine-distinguishable pr:watch / pr:merge-ready reason codes (including ci_never_scheduled), review-cycle thrash caps and BLOCKED handoffs, SLizard non-blocking wait policy, and an opt-in outage merge playbook — without defaulting to skip-ci.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Extend packages/core/src/pr-watch and packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness modules to emit distinct reason codes: ci_never_scheduled, runner_capacity_stall, ci_failures, ci_cancelled_no_failover, plus existing greptile fields; expose in --json and add unit tests.
2. Edit content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md for thrash caps (empty-commit/close-reopen limits), BLOCKED handoff template, SLizard advisory-only for merge-ready wait, and opt-in outage admin-merge playbook; cross-link envelope SLA (#3153) and sibling CI workflow #3168.
3. Wire any CLI/task help strings for the new codes; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3167; verify with core tests and task check.
narratives.UserStory: As a review-cycle owner, I want pr:watch to name CI weather states and thrash caps, so that agents stop multi-hour re-push loops when Greptile is clean but Actions never schedules checks.

items.title: pr:watch reason codes for CI weather

narrative.Acceptance: Given a PR HEAD with no required CI check-run within the probe window, when pr:watch or pr:merge-ready runs with --json, then the result distinguishes ci_never_scheduled from runner_capacity_stall, completed ci_failures, and ci_cancelled_no_failover.

items.title: Review-cycle thrash caps and BLOCKED handoff

narrative.Acceptance: Given review-cycle babysit under ci_never_scheduled or capacity stall, when re-trigger attempts hit the documented cap, then the skill requires a structured BLOCKED handoff instead of unbounded empty-commit or close-reopen loops.
Given merge-ready wait policy, when Greptile Step 6 is clean, then SLizard is not a wait gate; outage admin-merge is documented as opt-in/human with audit comment, not autonomous default skip-ci.

expected_outputs: pr:watch/pr:merge-ready CI weather reason codes + tests
review-cycle thrash caps and SLizard non-blocking
